question: According to Census of India 2011, which district in India has the lowest literacy rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alirajpur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alirajpur** district in Madhya Pradesh has the lowest literacy rate in India as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The literacy rate of Alirajpur district is significantly lower compared to other districts in the country.
 
• The Census of India 2011 provides a comprehensive analysis of literacy rates across various districts, highlighting areas that require focused educational interventions.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve literacy rates in districts with lower educational attainment through various government programs and initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years, providing critical data on the demographic, social, and economic characteristics of the population.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country, conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• Literacy rate is defined as the percentage of people aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• The government has launched several schemes such as the **Saakshar Bharat Mission** to improve literacy rates, especially in rural and backward regions.
 
• Improving literacy rates is essential for socio-economic development and empowerment of individuals.
